Package xmlro is a read-only pull reader for XML documents shaped like the parts of an Office Open XML package: one encoding, no DTD, deep repetition of a few element shapes, and a caller that wants a handful of the elements and none of the rest.
Package report renders Soundcheck results: the live terminal view, plain text for logs and screen readers, JSON, Markdown, JUnit XML and a standalone HTML report with before/after sliders.

Package report renders Echo's results: a live line per captured message (`rhythm echo watch`), the terminal summary of a run or a comparison, plain text for logs and screen readers, JSON, Markdown, JUnit XML, a standalone HTML inbox with message previews and a print-ready agency report that sums up a site's comparisons.
Package dmarc contains reader and parser for DMARC xml reports.
Package xlsx provides a pure-Go reader and writer for Office Open XML spreadsheet files (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .xltm).
+build ignore
Package itl defines data types for importing iTunes Library XML (plist) files.
Package ipc2581 reads IPC-2581 (revision A/B/C) interchange XML into the neutral IR (agni.v1.ir).
Package for reading large xml files line by line
Package goxlsx accesses Excel 2007 (.xslx) for reading.

ranking_metric_definition: Number of packages importing the given package, as displayed in pkg.go.dev search results. Missing counts remain null. Used only within Go, never compared with npm downloads.
